title: Long operation: supported drain or durable continuation
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare completion within declared HTTP/drain limits with checkpointed asynchronous continuation while retaining the same operation and original absolute user deadline.
preconditions: A browser supporting standard local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
One fixed read-only synthetic operation, 12 work units, start 0 ms and cutover 4000 ms.
No account, authentication, subscription, server, credentials or application framework.
actions: Choose drain or durable continuation and one of four bounded synthetic conditions.
Set integer original user, drain and per-request HTTP limits.
Run, inspect measured synthetic elapsed time and ordered trace, predict and check the outcome.
Retain up to six immutable run records; reset explicitly by mouse or keyboard.
trace: Pure fixed integer-clock events, including operation ID and original absolute deadline on every event.
assertions: Drain completes only within both declared host and drain limits.
Durable acceptance/checkpoint precedes old-host retirement; HTTP 202 is not completion.
Successor continues the same operation from four proved units, not from an invented fresh operation.
Retry-only time never replaces elapsed time from original admission; inclusive original deadlines apply.
Active-work termination and known budget/limit violations interrupt; unknown proof never becomes success.
Prediction verifier verdict and user-impact outcome remain separate.
Invalid input/state cannot retain a current success or erase historical failures.
Six runs maximum; explicit reset restores controls, prediction, history and keyboard focus.

iac.order: After genuine behavioral RED and before implementation

testRuntime.purpose: Existing offline test tooling only; not production runtime certification

limits: No native Azure, real HTTP, durable storage, business write or exactly-once effect is tested.
All operation identities, host limits, checkpoints, receipts, timestamps and results are synthetic.
Native Azure result is always unknown; no reliability or five-nines claim.
B-S042 and D-S042 native acceptance remain unfulfilled; S041 is not changed.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity registration, deployment, expenditure, downloads or packages.
History is in memory only, with six runs maximum; reloading also clears it.
The browser helper retains its documented unattended lifecycle limitation; its abandoned prototype is not used.
